title: Service categories (categories.yaml)
description: Required. A list of categories; services, life events and the city config's serviceGuide.categoryColors refer to them by slug. Read by catalog_loader.load_categories into app.models.ServiceCategory, and by the frontend build (frontend/plugins/cityConfigPlugin.ts) for category colour order, which reads each slug from a plain 'slug: value' line.

slug.description: Unique machine name: lowercase words joined by underscores (mental_health). Reuse the slugs the engine knows where they fit (docs/DATA_PACK.md).

icon.description: Material icon name, for example LocalHospital. Informational.

color.description: Hex colour. Informational: the UI colours categories from the city config (serviceGuide.categoryColors) and the theme.

service_count.description: Ignored: recomputed at startup. Omit or set 0.
